newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia market unruffled by Foster's loss.
newsitem.headline: Australia market unruffled by Foster's loss.

text.p: News that Australian beermaker Foster's Brewing Group Ltd would book a A$24 million abnormal loss hardly raised an eyebrow in the local share market on Thursday.

The charge, which is the cost to Foster's of a dispute settlement between its Canadian associate Molson Breweries and U.S. brewer Adolph Coors Co, was roughly in line with market expectations, a stock analyst said.
"I don't think it's going to shift the price that much," a Sydney based analyst said. Foster's shares stood at A$2.60 at 0147 GMT (11.47 a.m.), one cent up on Wednesday's close.
